season_context: August Pre-Season Planning Brief (3 weeks prior to peak hurricane window)

who_cannot_leave.priority_reason: 890 households without a vehicle (46.2%) and 31.4% aged 65+; nearest shelter with recorded wheelchair access is 8.4 km away (5 closer shelters have UNRECORDED accessibility).
745 zero-vehicle households plus 185 mobile homes; 11.2 km to nearest recorded wheelchair-accessible shelter.

maps_live_verification.summary: Confirmed active public high school at 1781 NW 95th St. Single-building live lookup indicates wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking, resolving the UNRECORDED federal flag.
maps_live_verification.drive_time_note: ~11 mins (4.2 mi) via NW 7th Ave from Tract 12086003604

maps_live_verification.summary: Confirmed active educational campus. Matches FEMA record for wheelchair accessibility and generator availability.

pre_season_gaps.title: Audit 5 High-Capacity Shelters with UNRECORDED Wheelchair Access Within 3 km of Tract 12086003604
pre_season_gaps.recommendation: 87.8% of county shelters have NULL wheelchair accessibility in the federal registry. Auditing the 5 closest EVAC shelters before September cuts accessible shelter travel distance from 8.4 km to 1.8 km.

pre_season_gaps.title: Pre-Position Paratransit Pickup Points in Tract 12086003604 & Tract 12086005303
pre_season_gaps.recommendation: 1,635 households across these two tracts have no vehicle. Straight-line distance exceeds walkable thresholds; stage paratransit shuttles routed to inland EVAC shelters outside the surge zone.

unrecorded_and_limitations: 88% of Florida shelters (and 87.8% in Miami-Dade) have NULL (UNRECORDED) for wheelchair_accessible in FEMA's registry. Blank means nobody recorded it—never 'No'.
HHS emPOWER electricity-dependent counts (18,420 beneficiaries) are published at the COUNTY level only and cannot be disaggregated to individual census tracts.
CDC PLACES does not publish LACKTRPT (lack of reliable transportation) for Florida or Texas; transport vulnerability here relies on ACS/SVI vehicle ownership (households_no_vehicle / pct_no_vehicle).
Assisted living facilities are state-regulated and absent from federal CMS nursing home tables.
